subject: Upcoming Team Meeting Agenda
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I would like to remind you about the upcoming team meeting scheduled for next Friday at 10:00 AM in the conference room. The agenda for the meeting will include project updates, upcoming deadlines, and a discussion on the new client proposal. Please come prepared with any updates or questions you may have. Looking forward to a productive meeting. Best regards, [Your Name]
